caption: FTP feed settings
preconditions: Logged-in user has the ingest_providers privilege (admin has all)
No real FTP server is needed: the source is not saved
steps: Open #/settings/ingest and wait for [data-test-id="ingest-settings"] to be visible
Make sure the 'Ingest Sources' tab is active
Click the switch #ftp-move so it is on
notes: Field ids are '<feeding_service>-<field id>' (IngestSourcesContent.ts getConfigFieldId), from the FTP field list in superdesk-core superdesk/io/feeding_services/ftp.py: host, username, password, path, dest_path, passive, move, ftp_move_path, move_path_error, allowed_extension. 'Move ingested items to' and 'Move *NOT* ingested items (i.e. on error) to' only show once Move items after ingestion is on. The brief says the e2e snapshot has no ingest providers; e2e/client/playwright/ingest-provider.spec.ts expects an 'Antara news provider' in the main snapshot, which does not matter here. Cleanup: click 'Cancel' in the modal footer.

caption: Connecting a Gmail mailbox
preconditions: No Google OAuth setup is needed for the shot: the Log-in with GMail button shows for any saved Gmail source that is not logged in
The source is created by the steps and removed in cleanup
steps: Open #/settings/ingest and wait for [data-test-id="ingest-settings"] to be visible
Wait for the modal to close and for [data-test-id="ingest-source"] with text 'Newsroom inbox' to be visible
Hover [data-test-id="ingest-source"] with text 'Newsroom inbox' and click its [data-test-id="ingest-source--edit"]
Wait for the 'Log-in with GMail' button to be visible
Scroll to the 'Log-in with GMail' button
notes: Gmail fields (superdesk-core superdesk/io/feeding_services/gmail.py): 'email' (read-only, only after log-in), 'Log-in with GMail' (url_request button, only when provider._id is set and no email yet), 'Log-out', 'Mailbox' (default INBOX), 'Filter'. Saving a new Gmail source skips the config test because the service has url_request fields (shouldSkipConfigTest). If saving fails on the e2e server, mark the shot skipped. Do not click the log-in button. Cleanup: click 'Cancel', then remove the source with [data-test-id="ingest-source"] 'Newsroom inbox' > button[title="Remove source"] and confirm.

caption: Editing a routing rule
preconditions: Optional: a content filter to pick under 'Add filter'; if none exists, leave 'No content filter defined'
steps: Open #/settings/ingest and wait for [data-test-id="ingest-settings"] to be visible
Fill the input with placeholder 'Scheme name' with 'Agency wires'
Fill the input with placeholder 'Rule name' with 'World news to World desk'
notes: Replaces image99 (old General/Filter/Action/Schedule tabs and 'Add new rule' button, both gone on develop). On develop the rule editor shows Content Filter, Actions (Fetch, Publish, Exit, Preserve Desk) and Schedule (Days, All Day, Start Time (inclusive), End Time (exclusive), time zone) in one column next to 'Scheme rules' (scripts/apps/ingest/views/settings/ingest-routing-*.html). Flow and selectors from e2e/client/playwright/ingest-settings.spec.ts. The action picker (scripts/apps/desks/views/actionpicker.html) has selects labelled 'Desk', 'Stage', 'Macro'. Cleanup: click 'Cancel' twice (rule, then scheme) or close the modal.
